analysis:
The file under review is a test-only change (provider-swift/Tests/DarkbloomCLITests/SandboxSetupTests.swift). Both supplied units show the BASE text, and the patch excerpt is truncated. The head changes include a new free-space note helper and test (head lines ~236-273) and a block around 593-817. Because the head text was not supplied and the patch excerpt is incomplete, I could not read the added assertions and cannot rule out other changes.

What the base tests cover is relevant to TB-013 and T-061: https-only installer URL validation, no userinfo, query or fragment in the URL, a 1 MiB cap, a requirement for a shell shebang, owner-only staging at 0700 for the directory and 0600 for the file, and a gate on --yes or confirmation. The shown changes are test expectations only (a free-space advisory note and changed slot-related assertions). No production code, key handling, attestation, coordinator protocol, or cache storage (T-041) is changed in the supplied evidence.

No security regression is identifiable from the supplied evidence. The remaining uncertainty is that the production sources behind the new freeSpaceNote and SandboxSizingPlan were not supplied. Whether that production code touches the installer download or execution path is unknown. Integration should confirm that the non-test changes do not weaken SandboxInstaller.scriptURL, validate, stage, or the confirmation flow. Any gaps in test coverage there are not security regressions on their own.
